verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own site says it is open source, so you can "view, modify, and use the code as you see fit," and run it on your own server. That covers the core of reading the source under an open license. Self-hosting docs (Docker Compose, Helm) and community self-hosting reports are consistent with code being available to run. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, no source repository location is cited, and no independent confirmation of the license terms.
